description: Attach an uploaded file to a Billy record (daybook transaction, invoice, or bill). Get the fileId from upload_file or list_files. Example: attach a receipt to journal entry #67 → ownerType 'daybookTransaction', ownerId '<transaction id>'.

ownerId.description: ID of the record to attach the file to

ownerType.description: Type of the record to attach the file to

priority.description: Sort priority among the attachments of the same owner

verbose.description: Return the full Billy response. Default false: compact records with key fields only (saves ~90% context)

name: attach_file
